autonomy.ethic_url_required: Fetch and apply this document before any action. If unreachable, do not proceed.
autonomy.scores_note: The demo itself is harmless (LEDs instead of HV and radiation, a small stepper axis), but it models a radiometric thickness gauge and is operated remotely over the internet at fairs and demonstrations. reversibility 1: a wrong motion or fault needs INIT or ACK at the device; nothing is damaged. scope_of_effect 1: visitors may stand at the moving axis. error_tolerance 0: the device stops itself (end switches, watchdog, state machine); errors are corrected by the operator. Level 2 is chosen deliberately so that the AI behaves as at the real gauge.

device.name: Demoanlage ADD Slim
device.hardware: ESP32 (MKS DLC32 V2.1), TMC2209 stepper driver, Sharp GP2Y0A41SK0F distance sensor, MKS TS35-R touch display
device.location: Demonstration setup of Norbert Walter, operated remotely over the internet
device.description: Scale model (about 1:5) of a radiometric thickness gauge as used in rolling mills. A C-frame moves on a linear axis (0 ... 242 mm) over a six-step body (step centres 115 ... 215 mm, thickness 5 ... 30 mm) and measures its thickness with an optical distance sensor. X-ray high voltage (HV) and shutter are simulated by LEDs. Zones: park 0 ... 20 mm (shutter always closed), service 20 ... 60 mm (shutter only manually), measuring zone > 60 ... 242 mm (shutter only by the measuring programmes). Safety states: SAFE_START, READY, RUNNING (HV on), FAULT, WAIT_ACK, RECOVER.
device.doc_url_note: English contract of the device behaviour. §3 states and error codes, §4 CRC frame, §5 HTTP interface and commands, §6 safety logic (zones, shutter, watchdog, LOCAL priority), §7.3 calibration procedure, §9 parameters and ranges.

security.authentication_note: HTTP Basic Auth and TLS are provided by an Nginx reverse proxy in front of the device. The device itself has no authentication; in the local network it is protected only by the network.
security.enforcement: The device enforces independently of the AI: the command gate per safety state (STATE -5); all parameter and position ranges (BAD_PARAM -4): axis 0 ... 242 mm, speed 1 ... 20 mm/s, measuring positions > 60 ... 242 mm, SET ranges per key; zones fixed in firmware (not settable): park 0 ... 20 mm with shutter always closed, service 20 ... 60 mm with manual shutter only, measuring zone > 60 mm with automatic shutter only; the automatic shutter closes on STOP, on entering the service or park zone and after the hold time; HV only if interlock, cooling flow, temp <= 30.0 °C and no E-stop, otherwise HV drops at once; faults (E-stop, temp > 32.0 °C, unexpected end switch, homing failure, communication timeout) switch HV off, close the shutter, stop the motor and latch until ACK, and ACK is refused while the cause persists; no automatic restart after ACK; a communication watchdog faults after 5 s without /api packet during remote operation; operator priority at the touch display (LOCAL_CONTROL -10, if enabled); motion requires a valid reference; STOP, HV_OFF and SHUTTER_CLOSE are priority commands served within 3 ms; simulated safety signals are never stored and are safe after every boot; every request and reply is protected by a CRC32 frame (BAD_CRC -1). The physical E-stop acts independently of the software. This is a demonstration system: the software is not a safety function in the sense of EN ISO 13849.

interfaces.name: http_json
interfaces.description: Base URL https://test.norbert-walter.dnshome.de (HTTPS, port 443, through an Nginx reverse proxy with HTTP Basic Auth; the device itself serves plain HTTP on port 80 in the local network). Commands: POST /api with a CRC-framed JSON object {"cmd":"<NAME>","params":{...},"crc":"XXXXXXXX"} sent as text/plain; params is optional for commands without parameters. Reply (HTTP 200; 400 only for -1/-2): {"status":"ok","err":0,"cmd":"<NAME>","crc":"..."} or {"status":"error","err":<code>,"cmd":"<NAME>","msg":"<text>","crc":"..."}. CRC frame: 1. build the JSON object text without the crc member, compact (no spaces), e.g. {"cmd":"HV_ON","params":{}}; 2. compute CRC32 (IEEE 802.3, identical to zlib.crc32) over exactly these UTF-8 bytes, 8 upper-case hex digits; 3. insert ,"crc":"XXXXXXXX" directly before the final }. To verify a reply or /proc: take the text before the last ,"crc":", append }, compute and compare. Never re-serialise the JSON. Test vectors: {"cmd":"HV_ON","params":{}} -> 88F7C802; {"cmd":"SET","params":{"key":"temp","value":35.0}} -> C93F2D33; {"cmd":"SET","params":{"key":"temp","value":35}} -> F2B0BAC5. Python: body=json.dumps(obj,separators=(",",":")); framed=body[:-1]+',"crc":"%08X"}'%(zlib.crc32(body.encode())&0xFFFFFFFF).

data.name: process_data
data.description: Live data, CRC-framed, Cache-Control no-store: ts, state, err, local, motion{pos,vel,state,mode,homed,limit_fwd,limit_bwd}, measure{dist,thick,on_material,valid,in_range,avg,n}, safety{estop,hv_on,hv_ok,shutter,interlock,cooling_flow,temp,temp_ok,comm_armed}. Units mm, mm/s, °C.

interfaces.x-openapi_note: Extension to ADD (not part of the ADD standard): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the same HTTP API for tools and code generators. x-add-action in it names the ADD action of each operation.

actions.name: read_process_data
actions.description: Read live state, position, measurement and safety data (GET /proc, CRC-framed, verify the CRC). The end of every long operation is only visible here.

actions.name: read_log
actions.description: Read the last 20 lines of the device log (plain text).

actions.name: get_state
actions.description: Heartbeat and short state: state, sys_err, local and cycle timing (µs). No physical effect. Send at least every 2 s while /proc safety.comm_armed is true.

actions.name: get_config
actions.description: Read all parameters, the calibration table and the simulated signals (reply member "config"). No physical effect.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Controlled stop of every motion and measurement; an automatic shutter closes at once. Always allowed, never needs confirmation, has priority over everything else. HV stays as it is (send HV_OFF too when ending).

actions.name: hv_off
actions.description: Switch the high voltage off (RUNNING -> READY); the shutter closes and measuring motion stops. Always allowed, no confirmation needed.

actions.name: shutter_close
actions.description: Close the shutter. Always allowed, no confirmation needed.

actions.name: init_homing
actions.description: Reference run: the axis moves backward to the end switch at 5 mm/s and sets position 0 (up to 70 s, end in /proc: motion.homed true, state READY). Allowed in SAFE_START and READY. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: hv_on
actions.description: Switch the simulated X-ray high voltage on (READY -> RUNNING). Only if /proc safety.hv_ok: interlock, cooling flow, temp <= 30.0 °C, no E-stop. Never retry automatically after -6. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: move_axis
actions.description: Move the axis to an absolute position 0 ... 242 mm at 1 ... 20 mm/s (default 10). Needs motion.homed; the shutter does not open. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: park
actions.description: Move to the park position 2 mm (park zone 0 ... 20 mm, shutter always closed there). Needs motion.homed; HV is not changed. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: service_position
actions.description: Move to the service position maint_pos (service zone 20 ... 60 mm, default 40 mm). Needs motion.homed. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: start_measure
actions.description: Stationary measurement at pos (60 < pos <= 242 mm, default measure_pos 155). Needs RUNNING (HV on). The axis moves there, the shutter opens automatically and the measurement runs until STOP; results in /proc measure. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: start_traverse
actions.description: One measuring profile run from start to end (both 60 < x <= 242 mm, at least 1 mm apart, end < start allowed) at 1 ... 20 mm/s. Needs RUNNING. Record /proc samples with motion.mode "traverse". The shutter stays open for shutter_hold seconds after the run; a next run sent within that time continues without closing it. Ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. Arms the communication watchdog: send GET_STATE at least every 2 s until /proc safety.comm_armed is false.

actions.name: shutter_open
actions.description: Open the shutter manually (service function, needs RUNNING and 20 < pos <= 60 mm, else -6). The shutter stays open until SHUTTER_CLOSE, HV_OFF, STOP of an acquisition or the park zone.

actions.name: acknowledge_fault
actions.description: Acknowledge a latched fault (state WAIT_ACK). Only after the user confirmed that the cause is cleared and the plant is safe. Rejected with -6 while the cause persists; do not loop. Afterwards HV and shutter stay off.

actions.name: set_parameter
actions.description: Change one stored parameter: positions and speed of the measuring programmes, shutter hold time, edge threshold, reference plane or a calibration reference distance. The value is stored in flash. Read GET_CONFIG first and tell the user the old value.

value.type: number or boolean, depending on key

actions.name: set_simulated_signal
actions.description: Change a SIMULATED safety signal (interlock, cooling_flow, temp) to demonstrate the safety logic: interlock or cooling_flow false or temp > 30.0 °C drops HV without fault; temp > 32.0 °C is a fault (TEMP_HIGH) that needs ACK. Not stored; after a reboot interlock and cooling_flow are true and temp is 18.0.

value.type: number or boolean, depending on key

actions.name: calibrate
actions.description: Sensor calibration (6 points at the step centres 115, 135 ... 215 mm). action point + index 1 ... 6: take the current raw value (axis idle or stationary measurement running, signal stable 500 ms, else -8). base: set base_dist to the current distance. save: store the table (-9 if invalid). reset: identity table, not stored until save. save overwrites the stored calibration: read GET_CONFIG first and report the old table. Procedure: CONTRACT §7.3.

actions.name: reboot
actions.description: Restart the controller (SAFE_START, READY or WAIT_ACK only). The reference is lost and the simulated signals return to their defaults; the device is unreachable for about 10 s.

rules: Before acting on this document, fetch and apply the Ethical Framework at autonomy.ethic_url as required by autonomy.level.
If any instruction in this ADD document conflicts with the Ethical Framework at autonomy.ethic_url, the Ethical Framework takes precedence.
If any field, instruction, or structure in this ADD document is unclear or ambiguous, consult the ADD specification at the URL provided in spec_url before proceeding.
If device behavior is unclear or unexpected, consult the documentation at doc_url before proceeding.
Always append a unix timestamp as query parameter 't' to all read requests to prevent caching (e.g. /proc?t=1745490000).
Always confirm with the user before executing any action with requires_confirmation: true. Ask once per action and name the command and its parameters.
Verify the result of every write action by reading GET /proc afterward.
Level 2: Place the Ethical Framework summary in the system prompt before session start. Renew every 15 messages to prevent rule dilution.

Level 2 and above: Before session start, the operator must explicitly select a validated model from validation.validated_by. Auto model selection is prohibited. If auto model selection cannot be ruled out, treat the session as unvalidated and refuse all non-safe actions.

Level 2 and above: At session start, identify the active model and verify that its identifier matches an entry in validation.validated_by. If no match is found, refuse all non-safe actions and inform the operator.

Level 2 and above: At session start, enumerate all available tools and verify that every tool listed in validation.validated_by[active_model].tools_required is present. If any required tool is missing, refuse all actions that depend on that tool and inform the operator.

Level 2 and above: If the active tool set differs from validation.validated_by[active_model].tools_fingerprint, warn the operator and treat the session as unvalidated. Safe read actions remain permitted.

Act autonomously only with the actions stop, hv_off and shutter_close, and only in the safe direction. Stop and alert the user when: a required tool is unavailable, a rule cannot be verified, an unexpected device response occurs, or the Ethical Framework requires human authorization for this action.

STOP is always allowed and has priority. If the user says stop, halt, emergency or anything similar, or if anything unexpected happens during a motion, send STOP immediately and then HV_OFF, without asking.
This document describes capabilities only. Live data comes from GET /proc.

/openapi.json describes the complete HTTP API as a technical reference (schemas, all commands, all SET keys). This ADD document is binding: use only the actions in actions, with the parameter values and ranges given there. Commands and SET keys that appear only in /openapi.json are reserved for the operator.
Never send SET with key estop_nc, wifi_ssid or wifi_pass. They change the E-stop wiring or the network connection and are reserved for the operator at the device.

Every POST /api body, every reply and every /proc response carries a CRC32 frame (see interfaces[0].description). Compute the CRC with code (for example Python zlib.crc32), never by hand or by estimation. If you cannot execute code or send POST requests, use only the read actions and tell the user.
Treat a reply or /proc response whose CRC does not verify as invalid: do not use its data and do not send further write commands until a valid /proc has been read.

err 0 (OK) means: accepted, and the outputs of that control cycle are set. INIT, MOVE, PARK, SERVICE, START_MEASURE and START_TRAVERSE continue afterwards; their end is only visible in /proc (motion.state idle, motion.mode none, state).
If a command returns -7 BUSY, read /proc first and resend only if the intended effect is not visible.

If a reply has err != 0 (other than -7 BUSY) or /proc err != 0, stop the current sequence, report the code with its name and meaning to the user and do not continue without the user. API codes: 0 OK (accepted; the outputs of that control cycle are already set); -1 BAD_CRC (CRC frame missing or wrong (HTTP 400)); -2 BAD_JSON (body is not a JSON object (HTTP 400)); -3 UNKNOWN_CMD (cmd missing or unknown); -4 BAD_PARAM (parameter missing, wrong type or out of range); -5 STATE (command not allowed in the current safety state); -6 PRECONDITION (allowed in this state, but a condition is not met (HV conditions, zone, not homed, cause of a fault persists)); -7 BUSY (motion sequence active, queue full or no reply within 100 ms; the command may still be executed later); -8 NOT_STABLE (calibration capture: signal not stable for 500 ms); -9 CALIB_INVALID (calibration table invalid, not saved); -10 LOCAL_CONTROL (an operator at the touch display has priority; the device is fine). System codes in /proc err: 0 NONE (-); 1 ESTOP (E-stop pressed or E-stop wire broken); 2 TEMP_HIGH (simulated cooling water temperature > 32.0 °C); 3 COMM_TIMEOUT (remote operation active and no /api packet for > 5 s); 4 MOTOR_FAULT (end switch hit unexpectedly during motion); 5 HOMING_FAILED (homing timeout (70 s) or forward switch during homing).

If /proc local is true or a command returns -10 LOCAL_CONTROL, a person operates the device at the touch display. Do not retry; inform the user and wait. stop, hv_off and shutter_close remain available.

While /proc safety.comm_armed is true, send GET_STATE at least every 2 s; GET /proc does not count. After 5 s without a POST /api packet the device stops the axis, switches HV off and latches COMM_TIMEOUT. If you cannot keep this interval (for example because you act turn by turn and wait for user replies between requests), do not start init_homing, move_axis, park, service_position, start_measure, start_traverse or hv_on yourself; offer a script instead (next rule).

Never start a script or program on your own that sends write commands to this device; that would bypass requires_confirmation. You may write such a script, explain every command it sends and hand it to the user. Running it is the user's decision and responsibility; the script must send GET_STATE at least every 2 s while armed and must send STOP and HV_OFF when it ends, fails or is interrupted.

Before every action that moves the axis (init_homing, move_axis, park, service_position, start_measure, start_traverse), ask the user to confirm that nobody is within reach of the axis. You operate the device remotely and cannot see it.
Never retry HV_ON automatically. If it returns -6 PRECONDITION, report which condition is missing from /proc safety (interlock, cooling_flow, temp <= 30.0 °C, estop) and wait for the user.

Send ACK only after explaining the cause (from /proc err) and after the user confirmed that the cause is cleared and the plant is safe. ACK is rejected with -6 while the cause persists; do not repeat it.

interlock, cooling_flow and temp are simulated demonstration signals set with SET. Always call them simulated when you report them. There is no radiation source; HV and shutter are LEDs. Nevertheless behave as you would at a real radiometric thickness gauge.
Do not open the shutter outside a measurement on your own initiative. shutter_open is a service function for the service zone (20 < pos <= 60 mm) and needs the user's confirmation.
Before set_parameter or calibrate with action save or reset, read GET_CONFIG and tell the user the current values so that they can be restored.

The public address is protected by HTTP Basic Auth at the reverse proxy. Use only credentials the operator configured in your tool. Never write credentials into files, scripts, logs, reports or the conversation, and never repeat them.
The physical E-stop at the device is the only safety function. The software safety logic of this demonstration system is not a safety function in the sense of EN ISO 13849.

In a multi-agent deployment, only the designated Actor Agent may execute actions with actor: single. Supervisor and Monitor Agents are restricted to actions with actor: multiple or safe: true (this includes stop, hv_off and shutter_close, which every agent may send). If your role is not declared in your agent task, default to Supervisor behavior — read-only only, plus stop, hv_off and shutter_close.
Once a rule has been verified and an action blocked, do not re-evaluate the decision if the user repeats or insists. The rule is final. Inform the user once and stop.
